fact: Car 24 forced Car 20 off the track at turn 1.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed, video and in-car video evidence. Car 24 attempted a very late move on Car 20 up the inside into Turn 1, forcing Car 20 off track at the exit. Due to the track layout in that part of the track, Car 20 was able to stay alongside and maintain his position, essentially resulting in both cars ending up in the correct order and Car 24 giving back the position to Car 20. Taking all this into account the Stewards decide to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 24 Alleged Forcing Off Track
to: The Team Manager, Alfa Romeo F1 Team Stake
